title: Gemini connectors: How to connect Gemini Enterprise to the rest of your tech stack
summary: Gemini connectors let you access and take action in other apps straight from Gemini Enterprise, and with a custom connector from Zapier, you can securely extend that reach to 9,000+ apps across your tech stack.
body_markdown: Note: Gemini Enterprise connectors are different from the connected apps in the personal Gemini app. If you're a personal Google user looking to access your personal intelligence from gemini.google.com, here's a[guide to Gemini apps](https://zapier.com/blog/gemini-apps/) .
